{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
target_group = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Count total orders in target group
total = len(target_group)

# Count how many of them have status == 'completed'
completed_count = target_group['status'].eq('completed').sum()

# Compute fraction converted
fraction_converted = completed_count / total

# Output
fraction_converted"}
